swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: TLV9002IDR is limited to 5.5 V max (7 V abs max, p.14) whereas MC33202DR2G supports up to 12 V (13 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS op-amp on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (MC33202DR2G: 190 °C/W vs TLV9002IDR: 207.9 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..105 °C vs -40..125 °C).
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and TLV9002IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to supply voltage Vs,max drops >20%. Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 12 V (p.1) vs 5.5 V (p.14), max Vos is 8 mV (p.3) vs 1.6 mV (p.17), input bias current is 80000 pA (p.3) vs 5 pA (p.17), and Iq/ch is 900 µA (p.4) vs 60 µA (p.18). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.8), thermal margin (θJA 190 vs 207.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
